text:
BIG-IP LTM v10.2.0
Commands Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 10.2.0
ACCESS::respond
- This command
generates new respond and automatically overrides the default
respond.
ACCESS::uuid
- enumerates the session IDs
that belongs to a specified uuid key by the order of its creation
and provides them in a Tcl list
LB::context_id
- Assigns the current
connection to named context.
TCP::option
- Gets or sets the value of the
specified option kind from the TCP header.
Events Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 10.2.0
XML_CONTENT_BASED_ROUTING
-
Triggered when a match is found in the XML profile.
